text.tspan: Measured in terawatt-hours of total energy supply. Traditional biomass refers to the consumption of fuelwood,
forestry products, animal and agricultural wastes.

tspan.tspan: Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2026); Smil (2017)
Other renewables include geothermal, biomass, and waste. In the absence of more recent data, traditional biomass is assumed constant
